name: Rosi's Schnitzelhütte
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Rosi's Schnitzelhütte in Tirol!**

Nestled in the heart of the **Alps**, this cozy mountain hut invites you to savor authentic **Tiroler** hospitality. Indulge in crispy **Wiener Schnitzel**, tender **Kaiserschmarrn**, and hearty **Käsespätzle**—all prepared with love and local ingredients.

Whether you're seeking a warm retreat after a day of hiking or a rustic feast with panoramic mountain views, Rosi’s is your perfect escape. Come taste the flavors of **Tirol** in a setting as charming as it is delicious.
